visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair and glasses, wearing a red and white horizontal striped t-shirt and light gray shorts, stands in a brightly lit kitchen. Behind him is a tiled wall with kitchen utensils and a dark wood cabinet. A pineapple-shaped clock is on the wall, and a green potted plant sits on a table with a lace cloth in front of him. (2) The camera zooms in on the man as he gestures enthusiastically while speaking. He maintains a smiling facial expression. A silver metal container sits on the table. (3) The scene shifts as the man begins cooking. He pours a bowl of small brown pearls into a pot of boiling water on a gas stove. He uses a metal spoon to stir the pearls. (4) He moves to a different part of the kitchen, pouring a thick white liquid from a plastic squeeze bottle into a metal bowl containing the cooked pearls. He then adds a handful of small, dried white fish from a bowl into the mixture. (5) He uses his bare hands to mix the pearls, liquid, and dried fish together in the bowl. He then transfers the mixture into a glass mason jar using a large metal ladle. (6) In a hallway, the man presents the jar, now filled with milk and straws, to three other people—one woman and two men. They all lean in to drink from the jar simultaneously using long white straws. Their faces quickly turn from curiosity to expressions of disgust and shock. (7) The man is seen in a living room, sitting on a sofa and drinking from a Milksha branded cup. Close-up shots show two Milksha cups on a wooden tray alongside a jar of honey. (8) A separate skit unfolds where a man in a striped polo shirt looks into an empty fish tank. He confronts the man in the red striped shirt, who is walking away while sipping the fish-pearl drink. Credits roll over a black screen with behind-the-scenes snippets appearing in small frames.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy synthesizer pop music starts. A male voice speaks with an exaggerated Vietnamese accent, greetings in Mandarin with high arousal. (2) A clear 'ding' sound effect triggers. The music transitions to a light, bouncy acoustic track. Vocal delivery becomes faster as he explains the cooking steps. (3) Sound of water splashing and liquid being poured. The speaker's pitch remains high and animated. (4) Percussive thud of a jar being placed on a table. The speaker mentions adding fish with a playful, mischievous tone. (5) Sound of slurping through straws followed by a chorus of overlapping chatter and loud, hysterical laughter from multiple people. A retching sound is heard as a comedic effect. (6) A sharp transition to a polished, professional commercial jingle with bright piano chords. The same speaker adopts a more standard, warm narrative tone for the product promotion. (7) Music fades slightly. Sound of behind-the-scenes chatter and natural laughter as the credits roll.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Comedic Cooking -> Social Reaction -> Brand Promotion -> Skit Payoff
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a popular comedic persona to create a 'gross-out' food preparation skit (mixing fish with milk tea) to grab attention. This then pivots to a genuine endorsement of Milksha's honey-themed beverages, using the contrast between the bad drink and the good drink for marketing impact.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of Milksha cups, clear branding on sleeves, and a dedicated segment praising the 'Honey Series' flavor profile.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively bridges internet comedy and commercial advertisement through character-driven storytelling. The 'Nguyen Yue-jiao' persona's high-arousal vocal style is a key feature for viewer retention.
